name: claude-config-map
description: Local browser dashboard for your Claude Code configuration. Scans ~/.claude (CLAUDE.md, rules, settings, skills, agents, commands, hooks, plugins, MCP) and every project listed in ~/.claude.json, shows the effective rule chain per project, and lets you edit files, toggle skills/plugins, and compare sections. Runs a Python 3.11 stdlib server bound to 127.0.0.1 only; no telemetry, no outbound network. Writes only files you explicitly save or toggle (with backups under ~/.claude/config-map/backups). The optional "edit assistant" runs your installed `claude -p` CLI with tools disabled and sends the open document text to Anthropic through your own account.
